text: Never, ever tell your mother: don't meddle in my life. Those words do not just hurt. They leave scars that never fully heal. A mother does not meddle to control. She meddles because she loves. Because she sees dangers you cannot see yet.

Every time you push her away, you tear a piece from her soul, even though she smiles so you will not notice. Think how many times she told you something you did not want to hear, and in time, she was right.
Think how many nights she did not sleep, worried about you, while you did not even know. And when she is no longer here, those words will weigh more than any mistake you have made.
If you explode when someone worries about you, it is not because you are a bad person, my friend. It is because you are exhausted inside. Your body has no space left to receive anything else.

Not even love. If you want to learn to receive love without it hurting, and live with a calm that does not hurt the people around you, everything I know is inside The Quiet Between Thoughts. The link is in my profile.
